headline: AMETEK’s (AME) $5B Deal Bets Big On A Hot Streak
summary: On August 26, AMETEK (NYSE:AME) closed one of the largest deals in its history, an all-cash purchase of Indicor Instrumentation for $5.0 billion. The timing is notable.
